description: Update an existing Alert Internal Note in OneUptime. Only include the fields you want to change - unspecified fields will remain unchanged. Use get_alert_internal_note afterwards to see the updated record.

id.description: The unique identifier (UUID) of the Alert Internal Note to update. Required. Use list_alert_internal_notes to find IDs.

postedAt.description: Date and time the note belongs to in the timeline: when it was written, or - for a note saved from a Slack or Microsoft Teams message - when that message was posted.

name: update_alert_internal_note
title: Update Alert Internal Note
